_about: Diethyl carbonate (1) + Isooctane (2): isothermal total pressures at 323.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of diethyl carbonate, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: R. P. Anugraha, A. Altway, G. Wibawa, Measurement and Correlation of Isothermal Binary Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Diethyl Carbonate + Isooctane/n-Heptane/Toluene Systems, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 2362-2366
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
